subject: Geopolitics
title: The US Shale Revolution
description: A short lesson to help you apply The US Shale Revolution.

hook.text: In 2005, the US imported 60% of its oil. By 2020, it was a net exporter. Fracking rewrote the energy map.

buildup.text: Hydraulic fracturing unlocked oil and gas trapped in shale rock.

discovery.text: Energy independence reduced US vulnerability to Middle Eastern crises.

twist.text: Shale is expensive and environmentally damaging. Low prices make it unprofitable. Regulation could limit it further.

climax.text: The shale revolution shifted power from OPEC to American producers. But its long-term viability remains uncertain.

punchline.text: Crack the rock and rewrite the geopolitical map.

quiz.question: How did the shale revolution change US geopolitics?
options: It forced the US to increase Middle East alliances
It reduced US dependence on imported oil
It eliminated all US oil imports permanently
